notes.title: Update 1.1.1: fixes and comfort
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This new Paragnosia update focuses on bug fixes and various improvements.

Here's the report:
[list]
[*] Bug fix: the minute hand on the room clock disappeared as soon as it passed the halfway mark.
[*] Bug fix: some anomaly sounds played at the beginning of a round.
[*] Bug fix: in rare cases, several Nemesis anomalies could be triggered in the same round.
[*] Bug fix: game minutes lasted 59 seconds instead of 60.
[*] Bug fix: if a joystick with a right trigger was jammed, it was impossible to take a photo with the other trigger or a mouse click.
[*] Bug fix: the end hatch could open while certain critical anomalies were playing.
[*] Bug fix: in rare cases, the camera movement sound continued to play indefinitely.
[*] Improvement: better selection of anomalies when there are few left to find for completion.
[*] Improvement: added a sound for sliders in the sound menu.
[*] Various text corrections.
[/list]
Best,

The Sine Coda team

notes.title: Anomalies Hunt update out now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are pleased to announce our 1.1 update for Paragnosia. We hope you will enjoy!

Here is the log for this update:
[list]
[*] Added some infos on the "remaining anomalies to find" panel
[*] All sounds integrated
[*] More options in the settings
[*] Full gamepad controls
[*] Better adaptability to various aspect ratios
[*] Now pausing the game when Steam overlay appears
[*] Cleaning up some bugs we found on anomalies
[*] (the secret)
[*] And more tiny fixes!
[/list]

Best,

The Sine Coda team
